### 2-Décomposition pour capter la tendance et la saisonnalite probalble

```{r}

```

### 3-Realiser le test de duckey fuller

```{r}
library(urca)
test_nottem <- ur.df(nottem1, type="trend", selectlags="AIC")
summary(test_nottem)


adf.test(nottem1)



```

### 4-test de la differenciation

```{r}
diff_nottem <- diff(nottem1)
plot(diff(nottem1),
     col="red",
     main="Serie differenciee",
     ylab="Valeur",
     xlab="Temps",
     lwd=2)
adf.test(diff_nottem)
```

### 5-test de l'acf et pacf

```{r}
acf(diff_nottem)

pacf(diff_nottem)
```

# Modele quradratique pour la trend

$µt=β0+β1.t+β2.t^2$

```{r}
t2=t^2
Airlm2=lm(y~t+t2,data = AirPassengers)
summary(Airlm2)
plot(Airlm2)


plot(t,y,type='o',ylab='AirLine Passengers',col="blue", main = "captation squarred ")

abline(Airlm2,col="red")

lines(as.vector(AirPassengers),type="o",col="navyblue")

```

```{r}
acf(AirPassengers)
pacf(AirPassengers)

```

```{r}
model=auto.arima(AirPassengers)
model
summary(model)

res_model = residuals(model) 
plot(res_model,xlab='Time',ylab='Residuals',main="Time series plot of the residuals")
```

```{r}
model1 = arima(AirPassengers,order=c(0,0,0),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=12))

model2 = arima(log(AirPassengers),order=c(0,0,0),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=12))

model3 = arima(log(AirPassengers),order=c(3,2,1),seasonal=list(order=c(0,1,0), period=12))

res_model1 = residuals(model1);  
res_model2 = residuals(model2);  
res_model3 = residuals(model3);  

par(mfrow=c(3,1))
plot(res_model1,xlab='Time',ylab='Residuals',main="Time series plot of the residuals")

plot(res_model2,xlab='Time',ylab='Residuals',main="Time series plot of the residuals")

plot(res_model3,xlab='Time',ylab='Residuals',main="Time series plot of the residuals")
```
